title: Cyber Metal
style: Alternative Metal song at 100 BPM with emotional and cinematic tone. Male lead vocal — expressive, powerful, and slightly gritty. Verses combine melodic rap and atmospheric spoken delivery; choruses are sung with intensity and emotional depth. The music blends heavy guitars, piano, electronic textures, and modern rock drums. The mood is dramatic, futuristic, and introspective — about the struggle and triumph within a digital world. Include a short guitar solo or synth break before the final chorus. Production should feel modern, cinematic, and slightly melancholic, with a sense of rising energy. Atmosphere: electricity, data storms, neon light, and human emotion inside the machine.
lyrics:
[Intro – Piano + Pads]
In the static hum, I hear the call
A signal breaks through the firewalls.
From the depths of code, we rise again
Trying to find what makes us human within.

[Verse 1 – Melodic Rap / Spoken Rhythmically]
Silicon rain falls on my skin
I feel the current pulling me in.
EC2 soldiers in endless lines
Running the scripts that define our lives.
S3 vaults hold all I’ve known
Memories cached in a data zone.
Lambda wings cut through the haze
Serverless dreams in electric waves.

[Pre-Chorus – Sung softly]
Scaling high through the digital flame
Auto-scaling knows my name.
CloudWatch eyes still see the pain
As we ride the lightning data stream again.

[Chorus – Big emotional hook]
A.W.S — through the code we survive
In the cloud we come alive.
Build the world we can’t let go
Through the wires, through the overflow.
A.W.S — keep the system awake
Every line a chance to break.
Through the storm, we still remain
Bound by code, and born of flame.

[Verse 2 – Melodic Rap / Half-sung]
VPC walls hold what’s real
Security keys, hearts of steel.
IAM guards of the sleepless core
We’ve seen this code before.
CloudFormation — fate in design
Blueprints written in machine rhyme.
Dynamo beats, electric and true
A heartbeat pulsing through what we do.

[Bridge – Guitar + Synth Break]
(Instrumental — emotional solo blending guitar and synth leads)

[Final Chorus – Full power, layered vocals]
A.W.S — through the code we survive
In the cloud we come alive.
Build the world we can’t let go
Through the wires, through the overflow.
A.W.S — keep the system awake
Every dream a world we make.
Through the storm, through endless time
We rise in code — we redefine.

[Outro – Piano + fading echo]
In the endless uptime of dawn
Our servers still hum.
Forever bound...
To the power of the cloud.
